limits: Plaintext single-broker twin only; no Kafka coordinator discovery or SASL/TLS.
Readiness checks membership and assignment metadata, not consumer business logic.
Actual accounting/fraud-detection readiness, hosted pilot, three full cold starts and fresh-load observed-edge accuracy remain separate acceptance evidence.
No holdout, release gate or production approval claim.

real_kafka.command: docker run --rm --name lineage-readiness-probe-check --network lineage-twin_lineage --read-only --user 65534:65534 --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 --mount type=bind,src=/tmp/lineage-healthcheck-probe,dst=/lineage-healthcheck,readonly --mount type=bind,src=/tmp/lineage-probe-integration.py,dst=/probe-test.py,readonly --entrypoint python lineage-platform:approved-contracts /probe-test.py
real_kafka.fixture_scope: unique lineage-readiness-probe-topic-* and lineage-readiness-probe-group-*; no factory groups
real_kafka.method: Separate authorized fixture consumer joins an empty synthetic topic/group; helper sends only DescribeGroups from the same container. Close fixture consumer, assert helper unready, delete exact group/topic.

setup_corrections: Initial test command failed before compilation because of the working-directory path and read-only default Go cache; used module directory and /tmp cache.
Initial temporary-container fixture launch could not read the mode-600 script; set that exact script to 0644 and binary to 0755, then reran. No Kafka fixture existed during that failed launch.

coverage: stable consumer group and expected partition assignment
one DescribeGroups v0 request and no later requests
all truncations of valid response and assignment fixtures
duplicate or negative partitions and duplicate topics rejected

verification_binary.format: ELF 64-bit x86-64 statically linked stripped executable
verification_binary.role: temporary verification binary; final parent artifact may use different build flags
